businesses.business: regulated natural gas and electric distribution, transmission and propane energy delivery

offering_description.value: Delivers natural gas, electricity and propane to residential, commercial and industrial customers through regulated distribution utilities and pipeline transmission systems. Also sells propane and compressed/renewable natural gas and provides related energy services. Operates its own pipelines, distribution networks and delivery fleets.

primary_products.value: natural gas; electricity; propane; compressed natural gas; renewable natural gas

primary_services.value: natural gas distribution; interstate and intrastate pipeline transmission; electric distribution; propane delivery; energy marketing and services

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential natural gas, electric and propane customers; B2B: commercial and industrial users, power generators, local distribution companies, agricultural customers

end_markets.value: residential heating and energy; commercial and industrial energy; power generation; agriculture; transportation fuel

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated tariff rates for gas and electricity delivered to customers; product sales: propane and compressed natural gas sold to customers; service fees: pipeline transportation capacity and energy services contracts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gas and electric distribution networks and pipelines, serving end customers and shippers; distributor: buys propane and natural gas and delivers to residential, commercial and industrial customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Delaware, Maryland, Florida, Pennsylvania, Ohio and the Delmarva Peninsula, propane in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: regulated energy distribution and transmission, propane distribution, and energy marketing and services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility service to metered customers and propane delivery to homes and businesses; other: pipeline and distribution network delivery to end users and shippers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates and operations regulated by state public service commissions and FERC, pipeline safety rules from PHMSA
